subject: general
question: The Muslim League was founded in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Dhaka.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​​Dhaka is the capital city of Bangladesh, in southern Asia. **The city's culture is known for its rickshaws, cuisine, art festivals and **religious diversity.**
 
• **Sir Mian Muhammad Shafi,** a prominent Muslim leader from Lahore suggested the political party be named as** 'All India Muslim League'.**
 
• **The motion was unanimously **passed by the conference, leading to the official formation of** the All India Muslim League in Dhaka.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​​​Modern Karachi **was reputedly founded in 1729 as the settlement of Kolachi-jo-Goth during the rule of the Kalhore dynasty.
 
• **The city of Hyderabad **was founded by the Qutb Shahi sultan Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah in 1591 CE.
 
• **Lahore was named after Lava,** **son of the Hindu god Rama**, who supposedly founded the city.
